# Golden Reels

> Golden Reels is a free, browser-based play-money casino arcade with two games: a three-reel slot machine and a six-deck blackjack table. It has no accounts, no downloads, no ads, no purchases, and no real-money wagering. The site is a lightweight HTML5 static site built for fast loading, accessibility, and clear rules.

Canonical: https://vip-81.github.io/golden-reels/
Last updated: 2026-11-04

## Key facts

- Price: free. No deposits, purchases, subscriptions, or cash prizes.
- Games: three-reel slots and six-deck blackjack.
- Starter bankroll: 1,000 virtual credits. The balance is stored only in the browser's localStorage and can be reset at any time.
- Platform: current desktop and mobile browsers. No download or account required.
- Slot paytable: three sevens 80x, diamonds 40x, stars 25x, bells 15x, lemons 12x, cherries 8x; exactly two cherries 1x.
- Slot RTP: approximately 90.3% under uniform reels, calculated from the published paytable.
- Blackjack rules: six decks, dealer stands on all 17, blackjack pays 3:2, no split, insurance, or surrender.
- Randomness: crypto.getRandomValues with rejection sampling for reels and a crypto-backed Fisher-Yates shuffle for the shoe.
- Privacy: no analytics, advertising, or third-party requests; no account or email collection. The hosting provider may keep standard request logs.
- Accessibility: semantic landmarks, keyboard controls, ARIA tabs and live status messages, visible focus, reduced-motion support, and high-contrast colors.
- Audience: adults 18+. This is a game demo, not a gambling operator.

## How to play

1. Open the page and choose Slots or Blackjack.
2. For slots, pick a 10, 25, 50, or 100 credit bet and press Spin. Three matching symbols pay the listed multiplier; exactly two cherries pay 1x.
3. For blackjack, pick a bet and press Deal. Hit, Stand, or Double according to the rules above.
4. Use Reset bankroll to restore 1,000 credits. There is nothing to buy and nothing to withdraw.

## Important distinction

Golden Reels is not a gambling service. Credits are virtual, have no monetary value, and cannot be exchanged for money or prizes. The site does not accept deposits or offer real-money gambling.
